summary: CardFlight draws its quad as two triangles (DrawPrimitive) instead of DrawColoredPolygon, so a collapsed or crossed quad no longer logs 'Invalid polygon data, triangulation failed' (64 times in a user's game.log); non-finite corners are skipped.
validation: Build ok; check-tutorial.sh and check-card-motion-ui.sh pass with no triangulation errors. The original error was not reproduced locally, so the fix is by construction, not by before/after.
remaining: Not the cause of the user's whole-system freeze (likely GPU driver); CardFlip has similar quad drawing, not changed.
